plan.title: Auction Dynamic Extension Trigger Below One Minute

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as a buy auction; rank is the supported reverse-auction strategy.
Provide the required event title so the later publish refusal is caused by the invalid trigger, not a missing title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Verify the delivery location was entered before continuing.

args.goal: on the single-stage auction configuration screen, enable dynamic time extension, set the trigger time to 0.5 minute, and stop with the configured 0.5-minute trigger visibly shown

steps.note: Configure and observe the dynamic-extension trigger, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add the two QA vendors needed for the auction.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.

args.because: Trigger time extension cannot be less than 1 min
